newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank hires hires Lehman banker.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank hires hires Lehman banker.

text.p: NationsBank Corp said Peter Morgan has joined the company from Lehman Brothers to head a newly created transaction development group in the mergers & acquisitions unit.

The transaction development group will gather and distribute market information, provide in-depth analysis of current issues relevant to M&A activity and research and apply creative thinking to new business ideas, NationsBakn said.
Morgan, a 12-year veteran of Lehmans, most recently was head of Lehman's transaction development group. At NationsBank he will be a managing director.
Lehman is a unit of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc.
